A '''data terminal''' was a portable [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. A former [[Unidentified former Imperial storm commando|Imperial storm commando]] managed to hijack a [[Hovertrain/Legends|magnetic-lift train]] and control all the functions from a data terminal that he carried.
